active_capture_basis: The loader captures ReadContext before it publishes Phase::Loading. An observed Loading state plus an unflushed accepted sequence establishes that capture before explicit flush.
body_facts: Generated body field content has 128 ASCII bytes per record; the stored native record also contains serialization and other schema fields.
NativeWriteRecord owns collection, key, and Option<Vec<u8>> body. Graph exact and ordered links share that record through Arc.
The read context captures the whole accepted graph, not only the requested 16 exact keys.
The source input fixes ordinary capture by retaining view.accepted beside the graph under one view lock.
public_status_limit: GET /api/status serves a sampler snapshot. Its deferred byte values and sampled_at timestamp cannot prove a subsecond reservation release time.
reservation_facts: The native mutation path quotes stored bytes times four plus staged path bytes times two.
A successful memory-ack admission stores DeferReservation in PendingBatch.retained.
DeferReservation drops its byte charge only when its owner drops.
The corrected ordinary read and preload contexts retain accepted PendingBatch Arcs together with their graph roots.
A flush clears only the runtime accepted owner and current graph; old read contexts keep their accepted owners.
PreparedCommit WriteProtection reserves disk space, not deferred memory.
scope: Ordinary synthetic Mini API observation plus source validation. No tests, diagnostic binary, primary data, archive data, or source data copy.
